rule: The appointment service of the Associations of Statutory Health Insurance Physicians (Terminservicestelle, phone 116117 or eTerminservice) must offer a specialist appointment within four weeks when the patient has a referral marked as urgent (Dringlichkeitscode).
For gynaecology, ophthalmology and paediatrics the appointment service also arranges appointments without a referral.
If the appointment service cannot offer an appointment within the deadline it must offer outpatient treatment in a hospital.

Specialists in certain groups (among them ophthalmology, ENT, dermatology, gynaecology, orthopaedics, urology, neurology, psychiatry) hold at least five hours per week of open consultation without appointment.
A GP who arranges an urgent specialist appointment for the patient (Hausarzt-Vermittlungsfall) receives a supplement; ask the GP to arrange it.
An initial psychotherapeutic consultation (Sprechstunde) is arranged by the appointment service without a referral.
Outside practice hours the on-call service is reached at 116117; in emergencies call 112.
